reference_findings.diagnosis: Acute inferior STEMI pattern; possible right-ventricular involvement and bradyarrhythmia/hypotension risk require urgent team assessment.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: Severe / emergency; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Inferior ST elevation pattern in II, III and aVF with reciprocal change in I/aVL in the synthetic tracing. Right-sided leads are pending in the initial data.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: Initial hs-cTn may be non-diagnostic early; repeat trend rises above the fictional assay threshold. Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL; potassium 4.3 mmol/L; CBC without major abnormality.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: LVEF approximately 45%; inferior wall hypokinesis. Right-ventricular size/function assessment is limited on first view; additional focused assessment is pending.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiogram: acute thrombotic proximal RCA occlusion, TIMI 0 flow before simulated reperfusion; left main without significant stenosis, LAD mild plaque, LCx mild plaque. Anatomy is fictional.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 52 bpm; BP 92/60 mmHg; RR 22/min; SpO2 95% room air; cool extremities and diaphoresis; reassessment required.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Sudden severe chest pressure with nausea, sweating and light-headedness for 45 minutes.
history.history_of_present_illness: Persistent symptoms at rest. Learner should recognize a time-critical presentation; the scenario is not designed to teach procedural steps.
medication_reconciliation: Fictional medication list incomplete at arrival; medication reconciliation pending
allergy_history: No known allergy documented initially; verify with patient/records

differential_diagnosis: Aortic syndrome if clinical features suggest it

pathway_review.label: Immediate STEMI emergency pathway and reperfusion-team activation
pathway_review.reason: The ECG/clinical pattern is time-critical; do not wait for troponin confirmation when emergency criteria are met.

pathway_review.label: Rapid assessment for RV involvement and haemodynamic instability in parallel with escalation
pathway_review.reason: Should not delay emergency reperfusion pathway.

pathway_review.label: Wait for serial troponin before escalating
pathway_review.reason: A critical timing trap in a compatible STEMI presentation.

reference_findings.safety_review: Emergency escalation; continuous rhythm/hemodynamic monitoring in simulation; document allergy status, renal function when available, bleeding risk and medication reconciliation without delaying time-critical activation.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: simulated reperfusion restores flow; post-event scenario monitors rhythm, blood pressure, heart failure and recurrent ischemia. Alternative branch: delay triggers deterministic hypotension/bradyarrhythmia event.
learning_objectives: Escalate in parallel rather than waiting for biomarkers.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
